output.reason: The evidence does not support the claim’s key conclusion. It states that the regime applies to “fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards” (effective date 2024-04-01) and that the relevant notification was amended on 2024-03-15. This implies that fresh loans availed on/after April 1, 2024 are within scope. The evidence does not state that the instructions were “not yet applicable” to fresh loans on April 1, 2024, nor does it establish the claimed status “as of 15 March 2024” beyond the amendment effective date.
